Package com.mimecast.robin.scanners.port

Class PortTlsChecker

java.lang.Object
com.mimecast.robin.scanners.port.PortTlsChecker
public class PortTlsChecker extends Object
Probes SMTP and IMAP ports for reachability and TLS certificate health.

For each port a TCP connect is attempted. If the port is open, a TLS handshake is initiated (either implicit for ports 465/993, or via STARTTLS for 25/587/143). The certificate subject and expiry are extracted and days-until-expiry calculated.
